description: Check how recently the local Apple Health export file/directory was written. Returns mtime, days_since_export, an is_stale flag, and a recommendation. Considered stale if the export is older than 30 days, or older than 7 days with no recent records (the inventory's latest-record date is also older than 7 days). Use before relying on apple_health_daily_summary or apple_health_wellness_context to confirm the export is fresh.
name: apple_health_export_freshness
title: Apple Health Export Freshness
